item.title: Portainer Git-Backed Stack Symlink Injection to Arbitrary Host File Read (CVE-2026-44881)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.9) — cloud · CVE-2026-44881 (GHSA-rpgq-m5fp-32wr). Status: Weaponized (complete end-to-end exploit script with recorded demo output on the upstream side; not executed while preparing this entry). Affects: Portainer Community Edition (Portainer CE), Git-backed stack deployment. Tags: Arbitrary file read, symlink, Git, Portainer, Docker, Kubernetes, CWE-59, CWE-200, authenticated, stack deployment.
